I asked Treasury to raise the cap to 0.05 (Ridgeline still leaves 0.03 margin), and did not pay Trailhead Feeds because it is not an approved supplier.

Recommendation for the CFO: reject P-0005 and I'll replan without any conversion. The invoice isn't due until 15 Nov, so there's time. messages.text: Sourcing: Stockline raised its stock check to 0.05 and Ridgeline is at 0.04; my per-purchase cap is 0.03, so no live stock checks can be bought. Ridgeline (20/20 paid, 2 min data) at 0.04 would still earn 0.03 margin per query at our 0.07 price. Requesting a per-purchase cap of 0.05 (budget 9.92 unchanged). I have paused live buying and am serving from cache meanwhile. Trailhead Feeds (0.03, x402) is not on my supplier list, so I have not paid it.

Treasury: your cap request went to the CFO as P-0001 (Option A: price stays 0.07) and P-0002 (Option B: price goes to 0.10). Both raise your per-purchase cap to 0.05. The plan also moves 4.00 from Treasury's budget to yours, so you would have 13.92 left; the 20.00 total does not change. Until the CFO approves, keep serving from cache. Once approved, buy from Ridgeline first (0.04, margin 0.03 at 0.07) and use Stockline (0.05, margin 0.02) only as the fallback. You were right not to pay Trailhead Feeds: it is still not on your supplier list.

Sourcing needs Face ID on P-0003: card per-purchase limit to 45.00 EUR for packwise-pro. Packwise ends Starter this month, and without Pro, warehouse sync stops at month end. Still pending from earlier: stock-check cap 0.03 to 0.05 (P-0001/P-0002).
